scientific_integrity: All-field claims are established by explicit coordinate and module/flag arguments. Exhaustive computational checks cover finite fields of order 2,3,4,5 for product counts and 2,3,4 for conjugacy orbits; they are not proofs of untested instances.
scientific_limitations: The prescribed nonzero product and Borel orbit classification is for ordered square-zero commuting pairs in the strictly upper-triangular four-by-four algebra. The zero fiber is counted but not classified geometrically. Higher dimensions, nonreduced schemes, and other conjugation groups are not covered. Historical priority and mathematical correctness have not been independently certified.
title: Nonzero product fibers and Borel orbits of commuting square-zero triangular pairs
